title: Field
description: The chrome every labelled control shares: FieldLabel above, FieldDescription and FieldError below, as react-aria parts so Input, Textarea and Select compose one copy of the label, hint and error styling.

anatomy.description: react-aria Label with data-slot="field-label". Variants: caption (uppercase, bark-500; the default) and title (sentence case, needle-950, for a field that heads its own card), mirrored as data-variant.
react-aria Text slot="description" with data-slot="field-description": muted bark-500 hint that lands in the control's aria-describedby.
react-aria FieldError with data-slot="field-error": heartwood-600 message that renders only while the field is invalid and joins aria-describedby.

usage: Render these parts inside a react-aria field root (TextField, Select) so the label, description and error are associated automatically; never wire htmlFor or aria-describedby by hand.
Field owns type and colour only; the control that composes it owns the stack (flex column, 0.2rem gap) and the control box.
Errors are the identity's only red: FieldError uses the heartwood ramp, and nothing else in a field may be red.
Prefer passing label, description and errorMessage props to Input, Textarea or Select; reach for these parts directly only when building a new labelled control.
Promotion precedent: three unrelated primitives needed the same chrome at once, which meets the rule of three, so Field was promoted on its first day rather than copied into each directory.
